_: The standings registry, v2 (results-lifecycle policy, decision 92; scenario redesign, decision 103). One entry per published perf/quality axis: the current-standings file (null until the axis has been measured), the single sha its rows were measured at, the release it was refreshed for, and `plane` (cpu or gpu), the source set whose digest decides whether the axis is still current. Every axis also carries hash_set (its plane's digest at refresh time) and refs (reference-library versions measured against), which let scripts/check_standings.py's release gate skip a refresh when neither has moved, and let `--stale` tell the refresh driver which axes a session must actually measure. Gates: scripts/check_standings.py; supersession is in place, git history is the archive.
